name: Min Stack
description:
Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant O(1) time.

Implement the `MinStack` struct:
- `Push(val int)`: Pushes the element val onto the stack.
- `Pop()`: Removes the element on the top of the stack.
- `Top() int`: Gets the top element of the stack.
- `GetMin() int`: Retrieves the minimum element in the stack.
hints: To achieve O(1) for GetMin(), you can maintain a second 'minStack' alongside your main stack.
When pushing a value `val`, also push `min(val, currentMin)` onto minStack.
When popping from the main stack, pop from minStack as well so both stacks stay in sync.
